proposal.summary: The message is an employee request to reset their account/password; it does not report a security vulnerability.
proposal.recommended_next_step: Not a vulnerability report. Respond to the user through normal helpdesk processes: verify their identity per company policy and reset/unlock the account or direct them to self-service password reset.

evidence_quotes.claim: This is a user request to reset password and unlock account
evidence_quotes.quote: Hi IT, I forgot my password again and now my account is locked after too many attempts. Can you reset it so I can get into the timesheet system before payroll closes today?
My employee ID is in my signature.
